description: ROD Master Combat VFX Tint, Shake & Placeholder Sheet Catalog — drives silhouette color-tint, impact shake, and temporary fallback VFX until per-skill 4x6 sprite sheets are completed.

enemy_guard.label: Enemy Guard
enemy_guard.desc: Active Guard shield points. Break all Guard points with Weaknesses or Guard-chip skills to Stagger.

staggered.label: Staggered
staggered.desc: Guard broken! Takes 1.5x damage and loses its turn.

boss_charging.label: Charging Attack
boss_charging.desc: Gathering power for a heavy telegraphed attack next turn. Break Guard or Stagger to interrupt.

hero_guard.label: Guarding
hero_guard.desc: Braced behind defense, halving incoming damage and empowering the next strike.

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.desc: Next attack or spell deals +25% bonus damage.

resolve_battered.label: Battered Resolve
resolve_battered.desc: Under 50% HP: Tier 1 Wounded Resolve passive is active.

resolve_critical.label: Critical Resolve
resolve_critical.desc: Under 25% HP: Tier 2 Last-Stand Resolve passive is active.

ko_fallen.label: Fallen
ko_fallen.desc: Knocked out at 0 HP. Revive with healing draught or spell.

ward_shield.label: Ward Shield
ward_shield.desc: Absorbing shield barrier protecting HP from incoming damage.

spell_empowered.label: Spell Empowered
spell_empowered.desc: Next spell deals bonus damage and extra Guard break.

marked_target.label: Marked Target
marked_target.desc: Priority target marked by Valen; takes +10% incoming physical damage.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.desc: Drawing single-target enemy attacks toward this protector.

adaptive_guard.label: Adaptive Guard
adaptive_guard.desc: Elemental barrier reducing repeat damage from the last element hit.

immunity_null.label: Damage Immunity
immunity_null.desc: Immune to specific damage types (0x damage).

boss_enraged.label: Enraged
boss_enraged.desc: Boss entered heightened Phase 2 fury (+15% Attack & Magic Power).

flee_blocked.label: Escape Blocked
flee_blocked.desc: Cannot retreat from a Dimensional Portal Guardian.

burn.label: Burn
burn.desc: Takes Fire damage each turn and receives 25% less healing.

bleed.label: Bleed
bleed.desc: Loses HP each turn from bleeding wounds.

poison.label: Poison
poison.desc: Takes Poison damage each turn and deals 15% less physical damage.

chill.label: Chill
chill.desc: Outgoing damage reduced by 15%; takes +15% Frost & Lightning damage.

shock.label: Shock
shock.desc: Next hit taken deals +20% bonus burst damage.

curse.label: Curse
curse.desc: Outgoing damage and healing reduced by 20%.

blind.label: Blinded
blind.desc: Attacks have a 22% chance to miss.

regen.label: Regen
regen.desc: Restores 10% Max HP at the start of every turn.

reflect.label: Reflect
reflect.desc: Reflects 25% of incoming damage back at attackers.

undying.label: Undying
undying.desc: Prevents Knock Out once, surviving at 20% HP.
